Well Plugging Grant

Application Period is Open

Through this grant program, the department provides financial assistance to identify and properly plug drinking water wells.

Who Can Apply

Community and not-for-profit noncommunity public water systems with at least one well are eligible to apply.

Award Amounts and Match

Awards are limited to a maximum of $20,000 in grant funds. Plugging public water wells requires a cost-share of 25% for each well.

Application Process

The department is accepting applications for Well Plugging Grants. Email water@dnr.mo.gov with questions.
